verdict.rationale: Netlify documents dashboard AI agents (netlify-docs-21), so an MCP-client axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows users can plug external MCP servers into Netlify for it to call their tools. 'Connect AI assistants to your Netlify account' describes the opposite role: external assistants reaching into Netlify, not Netlify consuming MCP tools. The AI Gateway (model access) and the SDK (developer building blocks) are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
